reason: THREAT-gate's one open finding: a pull request from a fork brings its own tower-gate.yml into the pull request and merge-group runs, so a required check bound to the GitHub Actions app can be made green by that workflow; nothing inside the repository can refuse it. The barrier is that only a writer queues a merge, under D-344's rule that a session never queues a fork's pull request whose diff touches .github/. Ends when a push rule refuses a change to .github/workflows/** on main except by the owner.
